Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. We've attached our completed onboarding form and W-9 so procurement can finish the vendor setup. A couple of things we wanted to check while paperwork is in process:

- Our standard customers are on Net-30, but we see some enterprise partners on Net-45 / Net-60 depending on invoicing cadence. Can you confirm Redwood's standard vendor payment window?
- We often offer a small early-pay discount for faster cash (typically 1–2% if paid within 10–15 days). Is Redwood set up to support early settlement programs or invoice-level discounts?

We hope to align the billing cycle so our billing and your PO cadence match and avoid invoice holdups. If there are any vendor-profile requirements or additional forms, please let me know and I'll get them over.

Hi Sarah — great to meet you earlier. Appreciate the forms; I've uploaded them to the vendor record. A few quick answers and next steps: 

- Standard: Redwood's default for new vendors is Net-45 while finance confirms credit/profile. That gives procurement time to validate PO routing and tax docs.
- Early pay: We do run an early settlement program on a vendor-by-vendor basis. Typical structure is a 1–1.5% discount if invoice is paid within 10 calendar days from receipt, but this requires finance and procurement sign-off and a simple PO addendum.

Neha / Marissa — can you confirm procurement's checklist and whether Net-45 is acceptable for Olive Systems?
Karthik — can finance evaluate a 1–1.5% early-pay discount and confirm whether 10 days or 15 days would be preferred operationally? If you want, I can draft the PO addendum and route it for DocuSign.

Sarah — if you’re flexible on the early-pay window we’ll try to meet you halfway to keep unit economics reasonable. I’ll loop back as soon as internal confirmations are in.

Best,
